regras.avatarClass: Templates Avatar are separate from normal scene templates. Choose them deliberately after reading SRT/Word narration and scene context; they use one Avatar and the underlying main scene, never reinterpret normal template slots. The templatesAvatar preset axis defaults off for older presets.
regras.avatarOccupancy: New normal templates reject any scene containing Avatar; multi-scene candidates are rejected whole, never repacked. Distributed Avatar skips scenes with normal templates. Whole-avatar placement may cover pre-existing normal templates and preserves them. An Avatar layout replaces only another Avatar layout, not a normal template.
regras.textFields: Every fixed label in a template ("CAPÍTULO", "TÓPICO", "PERFIL"…) is a SLOT for script text, never content: pass `campos` to studio_aplicar_template with the text derived from the speech of that stretch (same language, same case, within maxChars). A template left with its factory label is a defect.
regras.speechLabel: A template whose field source is "speech" writes the spoken caption of the take itself and COVERS the standard caption in that stretch (the editor hides it automatically) — never add a duplicate caption.
